posts.text: Freeze nights are coming to Atlanta. A pool pump that stops on a 28° night can crack pipes and equipment. We check your freeze protection and timers so your pool rides out the cold. Call BluVantage Pools for a winter check.

Thinking about closing your pool for the winter? In Atlanta, most pools do better kept open with weekly care: cleaner water in spring, no green swamp to fix in April. Ask us which option fits your pool.
Leaves are the #1 problem for Atlanta pools in late fall. They clog skimmers, stain plaster and eat your chlorine. Weekly service keeps baskets empty and the water balanced while the trees drop.
Hosting family this week? We hope your weekend is relaxing. Your pool is one thing you don't need to think about: weekly cleaning, chemicals and equipment checks, done by BluVantage Pools.
Winter is the best time to fix pool equipment. Pumps, filters and heaters are cheaper to repair now than in May when everyone needs them. Book an equipment check with BluVantage Pools.

Is your pool's plaster rough, stained or peeling? Winter is the best time to resurface: crews are easier to book and the pool is ready before swim season. BluVantage Pools handles the drain, prep and new finish. Call for a renovation quote.
Low water + cold weather = damaged equipment. Keep the water level halfway up the skimmer all winter so the pump never runs dry. Not sure it's right? We'll check it on our next visit.
Give yourself a pool you don't have to worry about in 2027. Weekly service from BluVantage Pools: skim, brush, vacuum, chemicals and a report after every visit. Call to get on our route.

Cracked coping or loose waterline tile is more than a looks problem: water gets behind it and the damage spreads. We replace coping and tile, and can refresh the whole pool at the same time. Call BluVantage Pools to see what a remodel would look like in your backyard.
